overall: The AG found no violation: the fire dispatch move was not reasonably anticipated by the chair, so it need not have been listed, though the AG urged postponing unlisted topics of public interest.

allegations.summary: Board discussed and voted to move fire dispatch operations to the county sheriff, a topic not listed on the notice, which fell under a budget review item.
allegations.key_passage: The Open Meeting Law does not require that the chair guess which topics might be raised by Board members
